WITH scoped AS (
 SELECT f.*,o.strategy,o.experiment_deployment_arm_id,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT (x.strategy,x.experiment_deployment_arm_id)) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.market_ticker=f.market_ticker) AS market_owners,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT (x.strategy,x.experiment_deployment_arm_id)) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id) AS order_owners
 FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
 AND o.id=(SELECT min(x.id) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id)
 WHERE o.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%'
), audit AS (
 SELECT *,coalesce(raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'count_fp',raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'count',raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'quantity') AS raw_count,
 raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'fee_cost' AS raw_fee FROM scoped
)
SELECT strategy,market_owners,order_owners,
CASE WHEN quantity IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 'nonpositive' ELSE 'positive' END AS stored_quantity,
CASE WHEN raw_count IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN raw_count !~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN 'invalid' WHEN raw_count::numeric=quantity THEN 'matches' ELSE 'differs' END AS raw_quantity,
CASE WHEN raw_fee IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN raw_fee !~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN 'invalid' ELSE 'explicit_nonnegative' END AS actual_fee,
count(*) AS fills,count(DISTINCT market_ticker) AS markets
FROM audit
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6 ORDER BY fills DESC
